At Aida Medical Aesthetics Medical Aesthetics, every treatment is crafted with precision, artistry, and medical expertise. Led by Board-Certified Family Nurse Practitioner Natasha (Neda) Hosseininia, our practice blends the latest advancements in non-surgical aesthetics with a deeply personalized touch. From Botox and dermal fillers to microneedling, our services go beyond the surface, helping you achieve natural, confidence-boosting results. Whether you’re looking to refresh, refine, or rejuvenate, we’re here to guide you through a seamless, results-driven experience in a setting that prioritizes comfort, safety, and trust. Board-Certified Family Nurse Practitioner Medical Aesthetic Specialist | Clinical Faculty | Women’s Health Expert Meet the Expert Behind the Glow The Passion and Precision of Natasha "Neda" Hosseininia With over seven years of experience in women’s health, primary care, and medical aesthetics, Neda has transformed her love for medicine and art into a practice that celebrates natural beauty and individualized care. Her background in painting and sculpting fuels her keen eye for facial harmony, ensuring every treatment is both science-backed and artistically refined. Beyond her hands-on expertise, Neda is also a clinical faculty member, educating other providers on the latest medical aesthetic techniques. She believes in honesty, transparency, and treating every client like family—because great results start with great relationships. “Aida Medical Aesthetics Medical Aesthetics was designed exclusively with you in mind. Join us on this remarkable journey where loyalty and trust are cherished, and let us pamper you with rewards for your unwavering support.” – Neda Hosseininia.
